feed.headline: Dairy-free swaps that keep the dish working
feed.sub: 4 swaps from one real tikka masala, and what to do differently with each
feed.photoLabel: Stock photo of the original dairy recipe, not the adapted dish

feed.headline: Chicken tikka masala, dairy-free, 4 to 6 servings
lines: Starting recipe: a RecipeFix Original, an AI-written home recipe

feed.adapted: 1 cup plus 2 tablespoons plain unsweetened dairy-free coconut yogurt
feed.why: Coconut yogurt provides an acidic, coating marinade without dairy; choose an unsweetened, unflavored variety.
steps: Stir the coconut yogurt smooth before coating the chicken; a thick, cultured variety clings better than a thin yogurt.
Let excess coconut yogurt drip off so the coating chars rather than pools.

feed.why: Vegan butter supplies the fat needed to soften the onion and bloom the spices without dairy.
steps: Check that the vegan butter contains no milk derivatives.

feed.why: Coconut cream restores the sauce's richness without dairy.
steps: Whisk separated coconut cream smooth before adding and keep the sauce at a gentle simmer.
Choose plain unsweetened coconut cream, not sweetened cream of coconut.

feed.label: Or, if you don't want coconut
feed.adapted: 3/4 cup unsweetened dairy-free soy cooking cream
feed.why: Soy cooking cream tastes more neutral, while coconut cream gives a richer body.
steps: Keep the sauce at a gentle simmer rather than a hard boil after adding soy cooking cream.

feed.title: What to expect
lines: The finished dish will have a gentle coconut flavor rather than dairy's more neutral richness.
The larger batch needs more broiler space, not longer broiling per piece.

feed.tie: Swapping an ingredient? RecipeFix rewrites the steps to match, and every change comes with its reason.
